name: Front-to-Back Gaussian Splat Rendering
definition: Renders semi-transparent Gaussian splats in correct depth order (front-to-back) using GPU radix sort to reorder splats by camera distance, followed by a loop of draw calls to maintain rendering order.
summary: Front-to-Back Gaussian Splat Rendering sorts splats by depth via GPU radix sort and issues sequential draw calls to ensure correct alpha blending, unlike parallel instanced rendering.
